einzeiler: Callers discuss a severe popcorn phobia, work crushes, and coping with flat-earther…
kurzfassung: Lyle speaks with callers about unusual and difficult personal situations. A 25-year-old man shares his intense, lifelong aversion to popcorn and crunchy snacks. Another caller, August, seeks advice on how to finally ask out a coworker he sees daily. Finally, Alicia talks about managing her relationship with her mother, who fell down a TikTok conspiracy and flat-earth rabbit hole.
stichpunkte: A 25-year-old man named Kyle shares his severe, visceral aversion to popcorn and the smell of it.
Kyle estimates it would take at least 50,000 dollars to get him to jump naked into a vat of popcorn.
August calls in because he freezes up every time he tries to talk to a female coworker who shares his nerd interests.
Lyle encourages August to simply start a casual conversation with her since they already know each other.
Alicia discusses how her mother became a flat earther and fundamentalist Christian after getting on TikTok around 2018.
Alicia maintains a healthy boundary by visiting her mother about once a month.
Lyle announces a bonus episode available on Patreon and reviews recent tour stops.

clips.text: Julie Pinheiro explains why she prefers traveling alone and hosts the podcast Solita.
